description: Land Title Settlement Department - Weragampita, Matara D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No. 820019
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of multiple "NOTICE CALLING FOR CLAIMS TO LAND PARCELS" announcements under the Registration of Title Act. These notices specifically deal with land ownership claims, land parcel registrations, cadastral maps, and land title determinations - all falling squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) which covers land registrations, property ownership, land titles, and land acquisition matters.
